Package com.kerosene.kfe.liquidity.adapters.in

Class KfeChannelLifecycleService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.liquidity.adapters.in.KfeChannelLifecycleService
@Service public class KfeChannelLifecycleService extends Object
Channel lifecycle: binary decision → optional LND execution → forensic row. Structural costs are attributed under SYSTEM_PROFIT policy (profit wallet must exist).

When kfe.channel.require-channels-mesh-inject=true, OPEN couples mesh CHANNELS soft-reserve → CHANNELS Taproot on-chain fund to LND address → LND openChannel → Intent commit (release on open/fund failure). Durable phase + stable Intent id enable crash resume and commit-retry. Open requires a mesh fund txid (no sole reliance on pre-existing LND wallet UTXOs).

  • Constructor Details

    • KfeChannelLifecycleService

      public KfeChannelLifecycleService(KfeChannelDecisionService decisionService, LightningChannelGateway channelGateway, ChannelsMeshInjectGateway channelsMeshInject, KfeChannelOperationDecisionRepository decisionRepository, KfeChannelRebalanceQueueService rebalanceQueueService, KfeHashService hashService, KfeSystemWalletService systemWalletService, KfeAuditLogService auditLogService, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper objectMapper, @Value("${kfe.channel.anchors-required:true}") boolean anchorsRequired, @Value("${kfe.channel.default-time-lock-delta:80}") int defaultTimeLockDelta, @Value("${kfe.channel.require-channels-mesh-inject:false}") boolean requireChannelsMeshInject, @Value("${kfe.channel.mesh-inject-fund-zero-conf-lab:false}") boolean meshInjectFundZeroConfLab)
      Creates the lifecycle coordinator with its policy, persistence, audit, wallet, and provider ports.
      Parameters:
      decisionService - channel decision policy evaluator
      channelGateway - Lightning node channel and on-chain operations
      channelsMeshInject - mesh intent operations used for funded channel opens
      decisionRepository - persistence for decisions and resumable workflow state
      rebalanceQueueService - durable rebalance job queue
      hashService - stable proposal and command hashing service
      systemWalletService - system profit wallet guard
      auditLogService - audit trail writer
      objectMapper - JSON serializer for decision evidence
      anchorsRequired - default anchor policy when a request does not specify it
      defaultTimeLockDelta - requested default, clamped to at least 18
      requireChannelsMeshInject - enable mesh-funded channel opens
      meshInjectFundZeroConfLab - permit the lab zero-confirmation funding path

    • openChannel

      @Transactional public KfeChannelDecisionResponse openChannel(KfeOpenChannelRequest request)
      Executes a passing open decision, resuming any durable mesh workflow before considering a new one. A previously opened channel with a pending mesh commit is committed idempotently, never opened twice.
      Parameters:
      request - requested peer, local capacity, and provider options
      Returns:
      persisted decision and execution/provider state
